description: This file defines the FollowersController class, which handles HTTP requests related to following and unfollowing profiles in a web application. It uses dependency injection for IMediator, and provides endpoints for follow and unfollow actions.

classes.name: FollowersController
classes.description: Controller handling profile follow/unfollow HTTP requests, utilizing dependency injection for mediator.

methods.name: Follow
methods.description: Handles POST request to follow a user profile using the mediator pattern.

methods.name: Unfollow
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to unfollow a user profile using the mediator pattern.
